claims.statement: After vainly challenging Mace, Tom Allen claimed the British heavyweight title, but Mace kept the belt.

claims.statement: Tom Allen fought Mike McCoole in St. Louis in 1869 for the heavyweight championship of the world; McCoole won on a foul in the ninth round, and Allen refused to concede.
